# The Doll Scout

Independent collectible-toy guides and free collection tools. Focus: Labubu / THE MONSTERS, SKULLPANDA, Jellycat and Sonny Angel. Not a toy seller or official authentication service. No live stock, popularity, resale-price or investment-return claims.

Choose a sealed box if the surprise is part of the appeal. If you only want one character, compare a confirmed item with the budget you could spend on repeated draws. More boxes never make a secret guaranteed.

Match the product: Check the full series, format, dimensions and box contents.

Check the source: Start with the brand’s official store or retailer directory.

Set your total budget: Include delivery and any import costs. Keep a hard stop for repeat draws.

Does TDS sell toys?
No. TDS provides independent collecting guides and tools. Follow a brand’s official source to check current products and retailers.

Is every featured collection trending?
No. These are starting points for different collecting tasks, not a live popularity ranking. We only label trends when we have dated evidence.

Can a checklist prove authenticity?
No. A checklist can help spot mismatches and prepare questions. It is not a certificate or an official authentication service.

Independent guides, free tools and links to official sources. We do not sell the toys, certify authenticity, or publish live stock and resale-price guarantees.

# Labubu / THE MONSTERS — Calculate a style’s odds

https://thedollscout.com/brands/labubu
Source review: 2026-10-02

Start with the exact series and format. THE MONSTERS figures, vinyl plush and pendants are different products.

Which one are you hoping for?

Calculate the chance of your chosen style before opening another box.

Have a Seat: Dada, Hehe, Baba, Sisi, Zizi, Ququ

Example: 12 independent boxes at secret odds of 1:72 give a 15.45% chance of at least one secret.

The regular-style model assumes the secret replaces a regular style and every regular style has the same chance: p = (1 − 1/N) ÷ K. The example uses K = 6 and N = 72. The official source confirms style names; it does not establish these model assumptions.

If your package states a probability for the exact style, choose “Enter a known per-style probability”.

Independent draws only. A sealed no-repeat case or a POP NOW box with hints needs different information. Missing a style earlier does not make the next box luckier. Set a budget before buying.

Check Have a Seat style names at POP MART: https://www.popmart.com/us/products/1372/the-monsters-have-a-seat-vinyl-plush-blind-box

Know the series before the secret.

Identify the release
Match the full series name, figure or plush format, dimensions and package contents against the official listing. A familiar character name is not enough.

Read the actual odds
Use the probability printed for that series. Our Labubu odds reference links its sources; it is not a live stock or resale-price feed.

Choose how to buy
Compare a sealed single box, a complete set and a confirmed character. Independent-box probability is not a guarantee of a case assortment.

Calculate a style’s odds: https://thedollscout.com/brands/labubu#style-probability

Official source: https://www.popmart.com/us

Independent guides, free tools and links to official sources. We do not sell the toys, certify authenticity, or publish live stock and resale-price guarantees.


# SKULLPANDA — Calculate style odds

https://thedollscout.com/brands/skullpanda
Source review: 2026-10-02

Explore the design, then check the format. A figure series and a plush pendant series need separate size and contents checks.

Which one are you hoping for?

Choose your target and enter the odds for the exact series. No brand probability is prefilled.

Image Of Reality: The Timelapse, The Paradox, The Pivot, The Merchant, The Soar, The Constraint, The Duality (White), The Duality (Black), The Philosophy, The Imagination, The Disguise, The Antigravity

Worked example, not brand odds: a 5% per-box chance gives 26.49% across 6 independent boxes.

Regular-style mode assumes one secret replaces a regular style and all K regular styles have equal probability: p = (1 − 1/N) ÷ K. Enter K and the printed secret denominator N. This assumption is not a verified brand rate. For several secret variants, use the exact per-style percentage instead of a combined secret rate. Use the exact per-style percentage when available.

If your package states a probability for the exact style, choose “Enter a known per-style probability”.

Independent draws only. A sealed no-repeat case or a POP NOW box with hints needs different information. Missing a style earlier does not make the next box luckier. Set a budget before buying.

Check the official series information: https://www.popmart.com/us/products/953

Make room for your favourites.

Enter your shelf’s inside dimensions and the full size of one piece. Compare an upright grid with a 90° turn.

Editable example measurements, not brand product specifications.

Example: a 40 × 25 × 30 cm space with 8 × 6 × 15 cm pieces and 1 cm gaps fits 12 pieces in a 4 × 3 grid.

This is a uniform rectangular grid, not a maximum mixed-orientation packing plan. No stacking, weight or stability check. Gaps apply between pieces, not at the shelf edges. Measure usable inner space and allow any extra top or edge clearance yourself.

Check the exact product dimensions at the official source: https://www.popmart.com/us/products/953

Collect the design you actually want.

Compare formats
The official Image Of Reality listing is a figure series. Do not use its dimensions or box contents for a similarly named plush pendant.

Choose surprise or certainty
A blind box offers a random style. If you want one specific character, compare the total cost and seller evidence for a confirmed item.

Plan the display
Measure the widest point, base and height of each piece. Leave clearance rather than filling every centimetre of a shelf.

Calculate style odds: https://thedollscout.com/brands/skullpanda#style-probability

Official source: https://www.popmart.com/us/products/953

Independent guides, free tools and links to official sources. We do not sell the toys, certify authenticity, or publish live stock and resale-price guarantees.


# Jellycat — Check plush size & fit

https://thedollscout.com/brands/jellycat
Source review: 2026-10-02

Choose a character, size and use. The same name can appear in several sizes, so compare the full product details before buying.

Will it fit your favourite spot?

Measure the plush in the pose you plan to display. Include ears, tails and limbs without squeezing it.

Editable example measurements, not brand product specifications.

Example: a 60 × 30 × 40 cm space with 20 × 15 × 25 cm plush footprints and 2 cm gaps fits 3 in one row when turned 90°.

This is a uniform rectangular grid, not a maximum mixed-orientation packing plan. No stacking, weight or stability check. Gaps apply between pieces, not at the shelf edges. Measure usable inner space and allow any extra top or edge clearance yourself.

For soft toys, pose and shape can change the required space. Do not assume a named size is the same across characters. This estimates display space, not packaging, safe storage or product suitability.

Check the exact product dimensions at the official source: https://us.jellycat.com/

A favourite that fits the space.

Match name and size
Copy the exact product name and size from the official listing. Compare stated dimensions with the space where you will keep or gift it.

Check the retailer
Begin with the official site and its Store Locator. A shop using the brand name or product photos is not, by itself, proof of authorization.

Record what you bought
Save the product reference, purchase date and your actual cost in a collection ledger. A sold-out listing alone does not establish rarity or resale value.

Check plush size & fit: https://thedollscout.com/brands/jellycat#display-fit

Official source: https://us.jellycat.com/

Independent guides, free tools and links to official sources. We do not sell the toys, certify authenticity, or publish live stock and resale-price guarantees.

Start with the series. Check the seller.

Identify the series
Compare the series name, package and whether the sale is sealed or opened. Do not assume every listing is the same kind of blind box.

Check the regional directory
The official store page separates online stores, distributors and retailers by region. Follow its current links rather than a sponsored search result alone.

Keep a duplicates plan
Record owned and wanted pieces before another purchase. Budget for a sealed surprise or a confirmed figure, without treating a secret as guaranteed.

Eine versiegelte Box passt, wenn die Überraschung dazugehört. Wenn Sie nur eine bestimmte Figur möchten, vergleichen Sie ein bestätigtes Exemplar mit dem Budget für wiederholte Ziehungen. Mehr Boxen garantieren kein Secret.

Produkt abgleichen: Serie, Format, Maße und Lieferumfang prüfen.

Quelle prüfen: Beim offiziellen Shop oder Händlerverzeichnis beginnen.

Gesamtbudget festlegen: Versand und mögliche Einfuhrkosten einplanen. Eine feste Grenze für weitere Ziehungen setzen.

Verkauft TDS Spielzeug?
Nein. TDS bietet unabhängige Sammelratgeber und Werkzeuge. Aktuelle Produkte und Händler finden Sie über die offizielle Quelle der Marke.

Sind alle gezeigten Sammlungen im Trend?
Nein. Sie sind Einstiege für unterschiedliche Sammelaufgaben, keine aktuelle Beliebtheitsrangliste. Trends kennzeichnen wir nur mit datierten Belegen.

Beweist eine Checkliste die Echtheit?
Nein. Eine Checkliste hilft bei Abweichungen und Rückfragen. Sie ist kein Zertifikat und kein offizieller Authentifizierungsdienst.

Unabhängige Ratgeber, kostenlose Werkzeuge und offizielle Quellen. Wir verkaufen keine Figuren, zertifizieren keine Echtheit und garantieren weder Live-Bestände noch Wiederverkaufspreise.

# Labubu / THE MONSTERS — Chancen einer Figur berechnen

https://thedollscout.com/de/brands/labubu
Source review: 2026-10-02

Zuerst Serie und Format bestimmen. Figuren, Vinyl-Plüsch und Anhänger von THE MONSTERS sind unterschiedliche Produkte.

Welche Figur wünschen Sie sich?

Die Chance auf eine bestimmte Figur berechnen, bevor Sie weitere Boxen öffnen.

Have a Seat: Dada, Hehe, Baba, Sisi, Zizi, Ququ

Beispiel: 12 unabhängige Boxen bei 1:72 ergeben eine Chance von 15,45% auf mindestens ein Secret.

Das Standardmodell nimmt an: Ein Secret ersetzt eine Standardfigur, alle Standardfiguren sind gleich wahrscheinlich. p = (1 − 1/N) ÷ K. Das Beispiel nutzt K = 6 und N = 72. Die offizielle Quelle bestätigt Figurennamen, nicht diese Modellannahmen.

Steht auf der Verpackung eine Chance für die genaue Figur, „Bekannte Einzelwahrscheinlichkeit eingeben“ wählen.

Nur unabhängige Ziehungen. Ein versiegeltes Set ohne Wiederholungen oder eine POP-NOW-Box mit Hinweisen benötigt andere Angaben. Frühere Fehlversuche erhöhen die nächste Chance nicht. Vor dem Kauf ein Budget setzen.

Have-a-Seat-Figurennamen bei POP MART prüfen: https://www.popmart.com/us/products/1372/the-monsters-have-a-seat-vinyl-plush-blind-box

Fruit Series: Raspberry, Peach, Orange, Pear, Strawberry, Grape, Watermelon, Melon, Durian, DragonFruit, Pineapple, Apple

演算示例，非品牌概率：单盒概率为 5% 时，独立抽 6 盒至少抽中一次的概率为 26.49%。

常规款模式假设：一个隐藏款替换一个常规款，K 个常规款等概率，p = (1 − 1/N) ÷ K。请填写 K 与包装上的隐藏款分母 N。这个模型不代表官方确认的品牌概率；多个隐藏款不能将合计概率当作某一个隐藏款的概率；有单款百分比时请直接输入。

若包装直接标注某一款的概率，请选“输入包装标注的单款概率”。

只适用于概率不变的独立抽盒。整箱不重复配货、POP NOW 提示或剩余盒排除，需要另外的信息。之前没抽中不会提高下一盒概率，购买前先设预算。

核对官方系列信息: https://www.sonnyangel.com/en/products/

选好系列，核对商家。

确认系列与包装状态
核对系列名、包装和未拆封或已拆封状态，不要假定所有商品链接都是同一种盲盒。

查阅所在地区的官方目录
官方页面按地区区分网店、经销商与零售商。应沿用目录中的现有链接，而不是只相信搜索广告。

先处理重复款与愿望单
购买前记录已拥有和想要的角色，为随机盲盒或确认款分别设预算，不把隐藏款当作必得结果。

计算想要款式的概率: https://thedollscout.com/zh/brands/sonny-angel#style-probability

官方来源: https://www.sonnyangel.com/en/store/

独立指南、免费工具和官方来源入口。本站不销售玩具，不提供真伪认证，也不保证实时库存或转售价格。


# Collector tools for AI assistants

https://thedollscout.com/for-agents
Source review: 2026-10-02

Find, read and call TDS collecting tools from an MCP-compatible assistant.

In a client that supports remote MCP, add this URL. No account or API key is needed for these read-only public tools. Setup and connector availability depend on your client; adding a catalog does not enable a connection automatically.

https://thedollscout.com/mcp

labubu_rarity_odds: Commonly reported secret/chase odds for Labubu / The Monsters blind-box series, by series format (6-figure, 12-figure, collabs, glow variants), with per-row sources. The box-printed odds for a specific series outrank every row returned here, and the result says so.
{"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false}

labubu_fake_signals: The eight authenticity checks for a Labubu figure (teeth count, face finish, box finish, anti-counterfeit seal, figure markings, build quality, price floor, seller of record), each with its named public sources. Compiled signals, not a guarantee; limitations are included.
{"type":"object","properties":{},"additionalProperties":false}

secret_pull_probability: Probability of pulling at least one secret across N blind boxes at printed odds of 1-in-oddsN, plus the box counts a 50% and 90% chance require. Independent single-box model — sealed whole-case allocation can differ, and the result carries that caveat.
{"type":"object","properties":{"oddsN":{"type":"integer","description":"The N in printed odds 1:N, e.g. 72","minimum":2,"maximum":100000},"boxes":{"type":"integer","description":"Number of blind boxes to be opened, e.g. 12","minimum":1,"maximum":100000}},"required":["oddsN","boxes"],"additionalProperties":false}

define_labubu_term: Plain-language definition of a Labubu / blind-box collecting term (blind box, series, regular, secret/chase, printed odds, case, glow variant, vinyl plush pendant, Lafufu, seller of record). Matches the term or its aliases; an unknown term returns the list of available terms, honestly.
{"type":"object","properties":{"term":{"type":"string","description":"The term to define, e.g. 'lafufu' or 'printed odds'","maxLength":120}},"required":["term"],"additionalProperties":false}

calculate_style_probability: Calculate independent-box chances for one regular style, a secret, or a user-supplied per-style probability. Required by mode: regular needs regularStyles and secretOddsN; secret needs secretOddsN; printed needs probabilityPercent. Regular mode assumes equally likely regular styles and replacement by a secret; not official series odds or sealed-case allocation.
{"type":"object","properties":{"target":{"type":"string","enum":["regular","secret","printed"]},"boxes":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100000},"regularStyles":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":1000},"secretOddsN":{"type":"integer","minimum":2,"maximum":100000},"probabilityPercent":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":100}},"required":["target","boxes"],"additionalProperties":false}

find_collector_tools: Find TDS collecting tools and guides by task. Returns canonical links, supported languages, inputs and which functions MCP can actually call. Browser-only collection records are never read.
{"type":"object","properties":{"task":{"type":"string","enum":["all","odds","display","collection","guides"],"default":"all"},"language":{"type":"string","enum":["en","de","zh"],"default":"en","description":"Interface language; some browser-only tools are available only in EN/DE."}},"additionalProperties":false}

get_collecting_guide: Read a published Labubu, SKULLPANDA, Jellycat or Sonny Angel buying guide with official source links, review date and limitations. Not current stock, resale valuation or authentication.
{"type":"object","properties":{"brand":{"type":"string","enum":["labubu","skullpanda","jellycat","sonny-angel"]},"language":{"type":"string","enum":["en","de","zh"],"default":"en","description":"Interface language; some browser-only tools are available only in EN/DE."}},"required":["brand"],"additionalProperties":false}

plan_display_fit: Calculate a uniform single-layer rectangular layout for toy footprints inside a display case. All dimensions use the same unit. Tests 90-degree rotation when allowed; not 3D packing or a safety/load certification.
{"type":"object","properties":{"width":{"type":"number","exclusiveMinimum":0,"maximum":100000},"depth":{"type":"number","exclusiveMinimum":0,"maximum":100000},"height":{"type":"number","exclusiveMinimum":0,"maximum":100000},"itemWidth":{"type":"number","exclusiveMinimum":0,"maximum":100000},"itemDepth":{"type":"number","exclusiveMinimum":0,"maximum":100000},"itemHeight":{"type":"number","exclusiveMinimum":0,"maximum":100000},"gap":{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":100000,"description":"Space between adjacent items; same unit as all dimensions."},"rotate":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["width","depth","height","itemWidth","itemDepth","itemHeight","gap"],"additionalProperties":false}

Use TDS to fit 8 × 6 × 15 cm figures inside a 40 × 25 × 30 cm case, with 1 cm gaps. Explain the limits.

Example result: 12 figures in a 4 × 3 grid, in one layer. No mixed orientations, stacking, weight or stability check.

The server cannot read your local collection, cloud account, private files or membership. Collection tracking and digital file tools run in their own browser pages; the catalog returns links and requirements. It does not claim to execute them remotely.

Public pages, text mirrors and the MCP catalog help compatible services discover the tools. Search inclusion, a recommendation and permission to call a tool are separate; none is guaranteed by this page.
